severity_levels.SEV1: Critical: full outage, data loss, or security breach affecting many customers; immediate revenue or safety impact; no workaround.
severity_levels.SEV2: High: a major feature is down or badly degraded for many users, or a key customer is blocked; workaround is weak or missing.
severity_levels.SEV3: Medium: partial degradation affecting a limited set of users, or a reasonable workaround exists; can be fixed within business days.
severity_levels.SEV4: Low: cosmetic, internal-only, or a single user with an easy workaround; no meaningful customer impact.

tickets.issue: Checkout returns HTTP 500 for all users

context.affected_users: ~100% of checkout attempts across all regions
context.metrics: error rate 98%, orders/min dropped from 1,200 to 15
context.started: 14 minutes ago, right after deploy v4.82.0
context.workaround: none
context.details: Stack traces show NullPointerException in TaxCalculator. Rollback not yet attempted.

tickets.issue: Primary database cluster unreachable

context.affected_users: all customers; every API that writes data is failing
context.workaround: none; read replicas are also lagging 40 minutes
context.details: AWS reports degraded EBS volumes in one AZ. Automatic failover did not complete.

tickets.issue: Customer PII visible to other tenants

context.affected_users: unknown; at least 3 enterprise tenants reported seeing other companies' contact lists

context.details: Suspected cache key missing tenant_id after refactor. Legal and security not yet notified.

tickets.issue: Login fails for every user

context.affected_users: all users on web and mobile
context.workaround: users with existing sessions can continue; no new logins possible
context.details: Signing certificate for JWT tokens expired at 00:00 UTC. Certificate renewal job failed silently last week.

tickets.issue: Ransomware note found on file storage server

context.affected_users: all customers who upload documents

context.workaround: none
context.details: Files are being encrypted in real time. Origin of the intrusion unknown.

tickets.issue: Minor blip on dashboard, probably nothing

context.metrics: duplicate charge records: 18,400 in the last hour
context.workaround: none; charges are already being sent to card processors

tickets.issue: Entire website down in EU region

context.workaround: job can be disabled, but deleted data restore requires backups
context.details: Inactivity filter compares dates in wrong timezone format, treating active accounts as inactive.

context.details: One Elasticsearch node has a full disk and shards are relocating.

context.details: Their dataset exceeded a 2GB memory limit introduced last release.

tickets.issue: Push notifications not delivered on iOS
